verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents only a single bearer-token API key per account (docs-3, docs-23, docs-32) with no mention of scopes, per-agent tokens, or granular permission levels; OAuth is offered only for the ChatGPT/MCP integration, not as a scoped API credential mechanism (docs-30). Super Admin capability even bypasses privacy controls (docs-45), the opposite of least-privilege, and no evidence shows configurable least-privilege API keys for agents.
